question: From the first year each actor appeared in a film to the last, how many actors in the database never had a gap longer than three consecutive years without at least one new movie appearance, meaning there is no four-year span anywhere in their active career without at least a single film credit?
sql:
WITH actor_years AS (
  SELECT 
    p.PID,
    CAST(m.year AS INTEGER) as year
  FROM M_Cast mc
  JOIN Person p ON mc.PID = p.PID
  JOIN Movie m ON mc.MID = m.MID
  WHERE m.year IS NOT NULL
),
actor_sorted AS (
  SELECT 
    PID,
    year,
    LAG(year) OVER (PARTITION BY PID ORDER BY year) as prev_year
  FROM actor_years
)
SELECT PID, year, prev_year, year - prev_year as gap 
FROM actor_sorted 
WHERE PID = 'nm0000288' 
LIMIT 20

WITH actor_years AS (
  SELECT 
    p.PID,
    CAST(m.year AS INTEGER) as year
  FROM M_Cast mc
  JOIN Person p ON mc.PID = p.PID
  JOIN Movie m ON mc.MID = m.MID
  WHERE m.year IS NOT NULL
),
actor_sorted AS (
  SELECT 
    PID,
    year,
    LAG(year) OVER (PARTITION BY PID ORDER BY year) as prev_year
  FROM actor_years
),
gaps AS (
  SELECT 
    PID,
    year,
    year - prev_year as gap
  FROM actor_sorted
  WHERE prev_year IS NOT NULL
),
actors_with_bad_gaps AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT PID
  FROM gaps
  WHERE gap > 4
)
SELECT COUNT(*) as actors_without_bad_gaps
FROM actor_years
WHERE PID NOT IN (SELECT PID FROM actors_with_bad_gaps)
</parameter>
